w10_P4_001962: A 115,000 g crate on a conveyor is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 3x² + 7x between x = 0 and x = 1. Eight identical drives each supply the force needed for this, and the controller sums the 8 outputs. It adds 7 N of belt tension and converts the total to kN. A 26 kN structural allowance is then added. What is the final value, in kN?
w10_P4_001964: A 193 kg engine block on a factory hoist is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to 9 more than the larger root of x² - 4x + 3 = 0. The hoisting force needed for this is converted to kN. The hoist chain is 6 m long. There are 3 hoists per bay and 2 bays, so the plant figure is the per-hoist value multiplied by 3 and then by 2. What is the plant figure, in kN?
w10_P4_001967: The total in a shipyard's winch report, in N, is 5 times a dock total. The dock total is 10 times a bay total, and the bay total is 7 times a single-winch pull. A single winch supplies the force needed to accelerate a 66 kg anchor block at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 4x² + 6x between x = 1 and x = 2. The winch cable is 30 m long. What is the total in the report, in N?
w10_P4_001969: The figure a rig operator finally records, in kN, is 3 times a single-actuator net force that is expressed in kN. The single-actuator net force is 11 N less than the force needed to accelerate a 98,000 g block at a rate in m/s² equal to the number of ways to choose 2 items from a set of 9. Three identical actuators act together on the rig. What figure does the operator record, in kN?
w10_P4_001970: An 88,000 g sled is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the slope of the curve y = 1·x³ + 1·x² at the point x = 3. The thrust needed for this is supplied by each of 4 boosters, and the range sums the 4 outputs. The sled track is 700 m long. There are 5 sleds per session and 5 sessions, so the campaign total is the per-sled sum multiplied by 5 and then by 5 again. What is the campaign total, in N?
w10_P4_001985: The figure at the end of a lift-test report, in kN, is 4 times a per-shaft figure. The per-shaft figure is 7 kN of margin added to a combined force expressed in kN. The combined force is that of 4 identical hoist motors, each supplying the force needed to accelerate a 121,000 g cabin at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 4x² + 5x between x = 0 and x = 2. What figure ends the report, in kN?
w10_P4_001986: The total on a dockside crane's load sheet, in kN, is 6 times a per-crane figure. The per-crane figure is 5 kN of wind allowance added to a six-cable total. The six-cable total is 6 times a single-cable force expressed in kN. The single-cable force is what is needed to accelerate a 182,000 g hook block at a rate in m/s² equal to the smaller root of x² - 7x + 10 = 0. What is the total on the load sheet, in kN?
w10_P4_002009: The final figure in a drone-fleet energy report, in kJ, is 15 kJ of reserve added to a fleet total. The fleet total is 11 times a per-drone figure. The per-drone figure is 20 kJ of battery reserve added to the energy of motion of one drone, after that energy has been expressed in kJ. Each drone has a mass of 14 kg and flies at a speed in m/s equal to the slope of the curve y = 2x³ + 4x² at the point x = 2. The drones operate at an altitude of 120 m. What is the final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_002018: A 33,000 g projectile is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to 7 times the larger root of x² - 10x + 16 = 0. The launcher must supply the force for this plus 3 N of guide friction. The launcher barrel is 2.5 m long. Nine launchers fire together, so the combined force is 9 times the single-launcher value, and the combined force is converted to kN. What is the combined force, in kN?
w10_P4_002025: The total in a go-kart team's energy report, in kJ, is 5 times a per-kart figure. The per-kart figure is 26 kJ of fuel reserve added to a net energy that is expressed in kJ. The net energy is 17 J less than the energy of motion of a kart. The kart has a mass of 22 kg and moves at a speed in m/s equal to the second derivative of y = 2x³ - 6x² evaluated at x = 3. What is the total in the report, in kJ?
w10_P4_002028: A 6 kg drone is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the second derivative of y = 1·x³ + 6x² evaluated at x = 2. The thrust needed for this, less 17 N provided by a tailwind, is the motor thrust. A squadron of 12 drones has a combined motor thrust 12 times that. A further 18 N of margin is added to the squadron figure. Two squadrons fly, so the total is twice that. What is the total, in N?
w10_P4_002030: The figure at the end of a rail-shuttle energy log, in J, is 10 J of sensor offset added to a corrected value. The corrected value is a fleet total less 8 J of gate loss and then less a further 21 J of brake loss. The fleet total is the combined energy of motion of 10 identical shuttles. Each shuttle has a mass of 18 kg and moves at a speed in m/s equal to the area under y = 5x² + 7x between x = 1 and x = 3. What figure ends the log, in J?
w10_P4_002035: The final figure on a bridge-jack sheet, in kN, is 28 kN of live-load allowance added to a subtotal. The subtotal is 12 kN of wind allowance added to an earlier subtotal, which is 30 kN of dead-load allowance added to a jacking force expressed in kN. The jacking force is what is needed to accelerate a 177,000 g bearing plate at a rate in m/s² equal to the slope of the curve y = 3x³ + 0x² at the point x = 1. The bridge span is 45 m long. What is the final figure on the sheet, in kN?
w10_P4_002040: The total in a lab logbook, in J, is 10 times a per-run figure. The per-run figure is 26 J of stored spring energy added to a subtotal, and the subtotal is 29 J of sensor offset added to the energy of motion of a 35 kg cart. The cart moves at a speed in m/s equal to the smaller root of x² - 15x + 56 = 0. The lab bench is 4 m long. What is the total in the logbook, in J?
w10_P4_002046: A 17,000 g projectile flies at a speed in m/s equal to the number of ways to choose 2 items from a set of 12. Its energy of motion, plus 28 J of launcher offset, is converted to kJ. The range is 1 km long. Ten shots are fired, so the range total is 10 times the per-shot value, and 15 kJ of reserve is then added. What is the final figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_002047: A 79 kg pallet on a warehouse conveyor is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the second derivative of y = 1·x³ + 0x² evaluated at x = 1. The drive must supply the force for this plus 5 N of roller friction, and the total is converted to kN. The conveyor belt is 18 m long. There are 11 conveyors per floor and 7 floors, so the site figure is the per-conveyor value multiplied by 11 and then by 7. What is the site figure, in kN?
w10_P4_002050: A 38 kg cart moves at a speed in m/s equal to the smaller root of x² - 6x + 5 = 0. Its energy of motion plus 9 J of stored spring energy is the per-cart figure. The cart is 1.2 m long. Six carts make a train and 12 trains run per day, so the daily figure is the per-cart value multiplied by 6 and then by 12. What is the daily figure, in J?
w10_P4_002051: The final entry on a hoist sheet, in kN, is 9 kN of counterweight assist subtracted from a subtotal. The subtotal is 14 kN of structural allowance added to a net force expressed in kN. The net force is 15 N less than the force needed to accelerate a 176 kg load at a rate in m/s² equal to the greatest common divisor of 38 and 41. The hoist cable is 22 m long. What is the final entry, in kN?
w10_P4_002052: A 14,000 g delivery drone cruises at a speed in m/s equal to the larger root of x² - 14x + 48 = 0. A fleet of 11 such drones has a combined energy of motion 11 times that of one drone, and the operator converts that combined value to kJ. The operator adds 26 kJ of battery reserve. Then 14 kJ of expected loss is subtracted. What is the resulting figure, in kJ?
w10_P4_002055: A 40,000 g tool head on a press is accelerated at a rate in m/s² equal to the smaller root of x² - 12x + 32 = 0. The drive force needed for this is converted to kN. Five heads act together, so the combined force is 5 times that value. The press log records the combined force plus a 21 kN hydraulic assist minus a 26 kN return-spring load, with the pressing direction positive, so the entry may be negative. What does the log record, in kN?
w10_P4_002065: A 46 kg cart moves at a speed in m/s equal to the slope of the curve y = 2x³ - 6x² at the point x = 2. Its energy of motion is converted to kJ. The cart is 1.5 m long. Two carts are coupled and 10 such pairs run, so the total is the per-cart value multiplied by 2 and then by 10. What is the total, in kJ?
w10_P4_002069: The figure at the end of a crane inspection sheet, in kN, is 9 kN of counterweight assist subtracted from a combined force expressed in kN. The combined force is that of 4 identical hoists acting together. Each hoist supplies the force needed to accelerate a 165 kg load at a rate in m/s² equal to 9 times the area under y = 4x² + 5x between x = 0 and x = 1. What figure ends the sheet, in kN?
w10_P4_002074: The final figure in a rocket-sled campaign report, in kN, is 27 kN of rail-brake load subtracted from a combined thrust expressed in kN. The combined thrust is that of 10 identical boosters acting together. Each booster supplies the force needed to accelerate a 190,000 g sled at a rate in m/s² equal to 5 times the sum of 2 and 14. What is the final figure, in kN?
w10_P4_002080: The figure at the end of a cycling-team energy sheet, in kJ, is a team total minus a 30 kJ energy budget, recorded as negative when the team is under budget. The team total is 7 times a per-rider figure expressed in kJ. The per-rider figure is the energy of motion of a rider and bike with a combined mass of 45 kg moving at a speed in m/s equal to the smaller root of x² - 7x + 10 = 0. What figure ends the sheet, in kJ?
w10_P4_002089: The total in a robot-arm report, in kN, is 5 times a floor total. The floor total is 11 times a cell total, and the cell total is 2 times a single-arm force expressed in kN. A single arm supplies the force needed to accelerate a 23,000 g payload at a rate in m/s² equal to the area under y = 1·x² + 4x between x = 1 and x = 3. Each arm has a reach of 1.8 m. What is the total in the report, in kN?
